sourceEvidence.title: Process Owner Manager - Investment Casting
sourceEvidence.quote: As the Process Owner Manager, you will lead and mentor the SE-BVT Process Owner team, which encompasses Wax, Monoshell, Cast, Rough (grain etch and core removal), and Finishing processes. Your role is crucial in ensuring that all SE-BVT castings meet stringent quality and metallurgical standards, while also achieving key performance objectives related to cost, lead-time, and quality. You will be responsible for establishing, standardizing, and implementing best practices across all product lines, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Additionally, you will design area-specific processes that enhance manufacturing efficiency and effectiveness. Your leadership will be instrumental in developing personnel and driving the team towards excellence in production outcomes.
